en: A colorized historical postcard view over a coastal town with wooden houses along a harbor, small boats in the water, and a large stone church with a tall tower and steep roof dominating the skyline. A long veranda-style building stands in the foreground, and forested islands are visible in the background. Handwritten-looking red text appears at the top left, and a small vertical serial number is printed along the right edge.
